tips: | Get out ranged, but if you can not-die in this lane, you will out-scale. He HAS to gain a lead in this lane or he becomes useless.

| Very hard to reach. Usually pretty zoned. Tend to get Second Wind and Relic shield to just try and survive the lane. Taste of blood will help with the sustain too. Very unlikely you can out-push her. Just look to out-scale her.
| Get out ranged, but if you can not-die in this lane, you will out-scale. He HAS to gain a lead in this lane or he becomes useless.

| She kinda just runs your ass down. Can't reach her. Her W seems to always hit you even if you stand behind minions. And once she's level 6, you have to position so carefully in lane or die to ganks with her arrow setup.
| Get out ranged, and she usually tends to permanently push you in, which gets difficult to deal with.

| Get ready to W the enemy bot laner. If you don't, this lane is terrifying especially after she gets ult. Try to get as much damage in as you can at level 1. Otherwise, she has kill pressure at all times.

| This is normally a winning 2v2 match-up, if you can react to him charging his Q with your W (only if he's in range) then you should win. If he can Q you but you can't reach him, then hes still usually pretty far and its easier to dodge it. Take ignite vs him, since if he's visible, he won't regen. Then you can E-W him immediately if he tries to hook you and you can usually kill him immediately if your lane partner also jumps him during the CC/reveal.
| Get out ranged. Can't trade. Your only hope is that she oversteps and you all-in her with your lane partner. Otherwise, you get poked out of lane after a few minutes. Second Wind is a must here.

| You can't interrupt his Jump very easily, unless you ult (which is a hard timing), and even if you do, his whole purpose was to get into your team anyways. Once he's level 5+, it becomes extremely difficult to play the lane safely and ward safely. The best you can do after he jumps in, is W him just before he lands, so that his follow-up is easier to dodge (his Q).
| Lots of gank angles and can't interrupt the Tunnel to prevent the knock-up. Tends to gank from behind. Play safe if the enemy bot laners have good gank setup.

| (Jungle Shaco) Lots of gank angles, very hard deal with and ward against. Your only saving graces is that you can E him, and if he stealths away, you can still see him. Otherwise a terror. | If they are Support Shaco, you need to start Sweeper to get rid of boxes in lane. If you get Ward trinket instead, he will control lane and the bushes.

| Your Q can't slow him when he snowballs, and even if you manage to cast W on him to stop the snowball, usually the snowball is STILL going to hit you. You have play quite defensively because he level 2 ganks, almost every game.

| If he has ult, everything you do does nothing to him. If he lands his Q on you, even if you slow or poly him, he usually has Approach Velocity and will continue to you run you down. I would consider Boots of Swiftness and Unflinching much more, to increase likelihood of escaping him.

| You have to be very careful not to overstep into his Flay range. If you're fast enough, you can auto attack him once, and back away immediately, and he shouldn't be able to reach you. But your next threat is he may walk forward and try to Q first. If you get hit by either ability, be ready to W his lane partner.

| You pretty much just auto attack him whenever you can, just be careful with attacking him too many times, otherwise minions start chasing you, which he can jump to, and once you are tagged with an Auto or his Q, most of the time, you have to get away from him ASAP.

| You will never be able to match his roam(even with boots of mobility, and thats a very big delay to your mythic item) but you should be able to do well in this lane. If he takes Relic Shield, his empowered autos usually will be used on the minion wave, and if you can dodge his Q at the same time, you can just beat him up.

| Relatively difficult to deal with since it will be hard to reach him. Bait his abilities until he runs out of mana, then you can make your move. If you must fight, then you must dodge his stun, and you'll stand a chance. Second Wind is very good here since all his skills are a DoT, and you'll get a lot of health back in lane.

| If she has Flash, and her stun ready to go, it gets difficult to get anything done as the enemy jungler might be ready to gank. And if you fall behind, even 1 kill, its gonna go downhill from there.
| You win most trades vs Janna, as long as you don't get slowed while inside of minion waves when trying to trade.

| If you position in the wave, she will try to Q you while you're in it. If you stand to the side, it should help a lot, since the Q range is actually quite short. If she has no Mantra, you can usually walk into the very edge of her Q range and side step immediately, and once its on cooldown, you can usually win the trade. But if you get hit by any Q, most of the time you will need to start backing up, or else get rooted by her W.
| Make sure you don't stand near your lane partner for a 2 man knock-up, and be ready to Poly him as he is head-butting you. If you time it properly, he just knocks you away to safety while poly-ed.

| Respect the hook, and if it looks like it becomes nearly undodgable, get ready to Polymorph his lane partner. (If you get pulled into range of his partner, you will Poly him and this will stop the follow-up damage). Play around minion wave sizes, Bone Plating and Guardian.
| As long as you can slow him as he tries to run you down, you should be ok. But if he hits you with his E, you might be in a lot of trouble. If he gets 1 kill in lane, he will snowball very hard.
| Stand behind minions. If he hits you with his W, a lot of Ezreals will follow-up with an E. That might be an opportunity to punish him.
| If he takes Phase Rush, you pretty much can't deal with him. If he takes anything else, you can stop almost everything he does.

| If you Poly him during his E, if you time it properly, he will charge at you for 0 damage, and not knock you back. Your projectile has to hit him just as he's about to attack you. But if you don't do that, and hes fed, there isn't a lot you can do about him.
| Attack his turrets and maybe even start Q. You need to get rid of his turrets as fast as possible as his strength will be you permanently push you in and poke you underneath your turret.
| Just be careful of taking the Splash damage from her auto attacking the minions with Rockets.
| Don't get auto-Q-ed. And if you do, don't get hit by W. If you can avoid all these things and keep poking her, she's gonna be hurting. You have more range than her.

| If you miss Q on her, you might be in a lot of trouble. But any Kalista player ranked Platinum or below is very unlikely to be a problem. They will not have the required mechanics to make Kalista the threat she actually can be.
| As long as he doesn't have his W on, you should win almost every trade. Probably won't be able to reach him late game though.

| As long as you don't get binded, you should be ok. Her E is pretty hard to dodge early, but you can shield yourself or your lane partner. Then just auto attack her for trades. Depending who her lane partner is (Caitlyn is the scariest), this lane can become unplayable very quickly.

| Its not really recommended to trade with her, her Auto Attacks hurt a lot, and once she's 6, she will probably slow you with E and ult. And very unlikely will you be able to reach her with Polymorph. But if you never try to trade with her, you should be ok.

| Dodge her Q and you'll probably win the match-up. But once she is level 6, she is much more of a threat as she can E herself, ult you, wait for it to Stun, then chain her binding, and there isn't a lot you can do about it.
| Shield yourself and auto attack her. You should win those trades and stack your spellthiefs faster than her. If you do this and dodge her Q, you should win.

| Play very defensive. At almost all points, he wins the match-up. But, if he misses his Hook (on you and the wall) then look to punish him as much as you can. Playing around your Bone plating and Guardian tends to help a lot. If you have those up and bait him to hook you while past your minion wave, you can usually win the all-in.

| Play very safe and wait for him to use his empowered Q on you, then you can step a bit closer as he needs his Empowered Stun to really dish out the damage. But otherwise, always respect his flash all-in potential. If he doesn't have flash, then you can W as he Jumps on you and you can then just walk away.

| You don't really have anything to match his engage or mobility. Your only play is to bait his W to miss you, and then Poly him when he misses, and beat him up. But once he's level 6, its a very hard lane.

| Once she's on you, there is very little you can do about her. Especially if she blocks your W with her W, then it's a lost cause. This lane heavily depends on her lane partner being able to proc her passive. If not, then you should be ok. If they can... this lane is unwinnable.

| Can't really reach her, but if she's using her skills at max range, she can't really do anything to you either. But once you're in range, if you can dodge her rooting you, you should be able to just beat her up.

| His support role has been nerfed a lot. He will repeatedly sit in a bush and Hexflash at you with Nimbus Cloak, and if you don't get stunned from his E, you probably win the lane, especially if you can Poly him and kill him before he casts W.

| (Support Shaco) - Start Oracle Lens and just keep clearing out his boxes and never over chase into an area you haven't checked in a while. And if you can E him before he stealth Q's away, you can still see him and beat him up.
| Dodge his taunt and you win the matchup. Beat him up.
| She scales better than you and you can't reach her very easily. But if she ever walks into range of your auto attacks, you should beat her up.
| As long as you don't get hit by her Q, you win. If you get hit by Q, she will out sustain you.
| If you get hit by E, you're probably in a lot of trouble. And even if you dodge it, if he has a lane partner that can also CC, you're probably going to die. Play very safe.
| If you get hit by his Q, get ready to run. But if he never hits you with it, just poke him down really hard and it should be easy.
| If he can stun you, then you're in trouble. But if that stun never lands, beat him up. Getting early boots might help a lot.
| She will probably be constantly pushing you in, but if you can stop that, then you should just win. If she E's you, back up and get ready to Polymorph her if she jumps on you.
| He needs a lot of time to scale. Beat him up. But once he scales, you probably can't reach him.
| I've yet to see him do anything since his Lethality/Poke build nerfs. Beat him up.

| This is probably the best ADC you can lane against. At all points in the game, you can reach her. If you E her before she stealths, you can see her if she Q's to stealth. If you Polymorph her, and she miss-clicks, she will run very fast into you and you can probably kill her.
| Once he hits level 3, you pretty much cannot do anything to him, and his gank setup is so strong its nearly impossible to deal with. You may as well just roam.
| As long as you don't walk at her, but walk at a diagonal at her, she should have a pretty hard time rooting you with her E. But if you get rooted, you're probably dead.
| If you can Polymorph him before he windwalls that might give you enough time to step away from minions before he can close the gap, but once he's on you, it might be a bit difficult.
| She eventually will mitigate all of your damage and at that point you can't do much to her. Try roaming early to get someone else ahead.
| Good to scale with, if you can speed her up, and the enemy can't turn on you, she pretty much just runs them down.
| Hard scaling ADC, scaling support, seems like a good combo.
| Hyper carry, keep her alive and she should kill everything.
| He has mobility issues, but if you actually keep him alive, he will melt everything. % hp damage is pretty good.
| (Mid lane, not bot lane) Just another Auto Attack based carry to help accelerate.

| (Mid/Top lane, not bot lane) Just another Auto Attack based carry to help accelerate.

| Hard scaling ADC, scaling support, seems like a good combo. Very good vs Multiple front liners. Vs 5 squishies, not as ideal.
